alt: Relaxed on the deck of a modern yacht, dark suit immaculate, coffee cup in paw, distant city skyline, a closed unbranded laptop; quietly triumphant expression.
Listening thoughtfully to an anonymous elderly human gentleman in a warm modern library; both seated, the Shiba calmly nodding beside a completely blank closed book.
Raising a single elegant clear glass in a modest celebratory toast at a warm evening gathering; close-up knowing smile, tasteful bokeh, no drinking labels.

Confidently at a plain unmarked lectern in a modern conference room with anonymous suited attendees; no flags or written signs; subtly surprised faces in the background.
Comparing an old stack of completely blank paper folders on one side of a desk with a modern glass server cabinet on the other; thoughtful confident expression; a single coherent scene.

Opening a completely blank cream envelope at the office desk, pleasantly surprised brows, a small stack of other blank envelopes nearby.

Tilting head slightly with one knowing raised eyebrow and a faint smile, close-up three-quarter portrait, clean pale stone office background.

Suspicious sideways glance over one shoulder, lips pressed in a tiny skeptical smile, charcoal suit, soft ivory backdrop, no words or symbols.
